summary: Mistral launched Agentic Search, a multi-step retrieval tool suite (search, open, navigate, read, grep) built into Mistral Search Toolkit and Libraries, reporting large accuracy, token, and latency improvements over one-shot RAG on FinanceBench and OfficeQA Pro benchmarks.

mechanisms.reason: The product introduces a multi-step agentic retrieval loop that issues multiple tool calls per query in place of single-pass search, an industry-level shift in how retrieval work is executed rather than a single customer's own architecture.
mechanisms.quote: Agentic Search introduces a multi-step retrieval loop for finding, inspecting, and verifying information across data sources, wherever it is stored.

mechanisms.reason: The document states a specific technique (navigation tools replacing repeated broad search) that reduces tokens consumed and latency for the same task, a stated efficiency gain per unit of work rather than a price change.
mechanisms.quote: Fewer repeated searches reduce token consumption by up to one-third.

practices.reason: The document describes a concrete, implementable retrieval architecture (five tools: search, open, navigate, read, grep) with stated accuracy, token and latency gains that a team could build directly on their own index.
practices.quote: Agentic Search builds on your existing search index using five tools: search , open , navigate , read , and grep .

practices.reason: The lab reports specific benchmark methodology and comparative results (FinanceBench, OfficeQA Pro, cross-harness comparison) that could inform how a team measures its own retrieval system, though the evals are the lab's own and unreplicated externally.
practices.quote: nanceBench (Islam et al., 2023) tests financial question-answering over 368 SEC filings (10-K / 10-Q / 8-K), averaging ~147 pages each, ~53,900 pages total: long, table-heavy financial documents. A

practices.reason: Adopting Agentic Search requires integrating a new toolkit and index-building workflow (Search Toolkit, Libraries) rather than being a drop-in change, but no deprecation or breaking change is stated.
practices.quote: stral Search Toolkit provides open modules for ingesting, embedding, and indexing critical and complex data in the cloud or on-premises. A
